# 我的博客

> 记录与分享

This is the llms.txt file for 我的博客. It provides a machine-readable directory of published articles and core pages for Large Language Models.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://duanzanjiu.github.io/blog/): Main blog entrance and latest post stream.
- [About](https://duanzanjiu.github.io/blog/about/): Author profile, technical stack, and background.
- [Archive](https://duanzanjiu.github.io/blog/archive/): Chronological index of all published writings.

## Articles
- [博客示范](https://duanzanjiu.github.io/blog/blog/posts/guide/): 描述一下博客的使用方法

## Full Text Dump
- [Full Text Archive](https://duanzanjiu.github.io/blog/llms-full.txt): Complete, concatenated Markdown content of all public articles for full-context ingestion.
